messages:
ajit: Heads up — payments team reports a spike in checkout 5xxs in prod us-east-1 starting ~11:42. They want an emergency rollback of the new routing flag (payments.new_routing). Quick Q: who is authorized to flip a kill-switch and what's the minimal audit text we must include?

maria: oncall can act for immediate customer-impacting incidents. Requirements: post an incident notice in #incidents, flip scoped if possible, include short reason + incident link in the audit field. Follow up with RCA assignment.

ajit: understood. Is region-scoped toggles available or do we have to disable globally? payments really wants region-only if we can.

ken: region scope exists. Use --scope=prod:us-east-1 or the CLI flag --region=us-east-1. Global only for full-service outage. Also check if canary was enabled first — if only 10% canary, prefer backing off canary.

priya: agree. If the surge is bounded to the region, do a region toggle. If it’s widespread across backends then global is acceptable. Also prefer gradual cut (canary->0) unless it’s catastrophic.

ajit: what’s the exact command so I don’t mistype? need audit log to capture initiator and reason.

maria: example CLI we use:
```
rw-toggle disable payments.new_routing --env=prod --region=us-east-1 --audit="INC-2026-60123: checkout 5xx spike" --by="@ajit"
```
That call will emit an event to the AuditSink (s3://redwood-audit/toggles/) and a message on events.topic.toggles. CloudAudit will also get a record.

sre-ops: confirm policy: only members of SSO groups (eng-oncall OR eng-sre-leads OR eng-platform-ops) may perform emergency toggles. Theres also a temporary allowlist for the current rotation (oncall + 2 sre leads). If youre in oncall you can proceed.

ajit: i have oncall group membership. creating INC-2026-60123 in incidents now.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-60123 created by maria. Sev: P2. Tags: payments, toggle

ajit: executing now:
```
rw-toggle disable payments.new_routing --env=prod --region=us-east-1 --audit="INC-2026-60123: checkout 5xx spike, rollback routing" --by="@ajit"
```

ken: saw toggle event landed. event_id: evt_toggle_2026_33421. AuditSink entry created.

priya: dashboards show error rate dropping in region within ~90s. keep monitoring for 15m and then hand back to payments for root cause.

ajit: monitoring for 20m and will add notes to the incident. Do we need to page product or execs?

maria: not required for P2. If impact expands to cross-region or revenue loss > threshold, follow exec notification matrix.

sam: post-incident checklist item: record who executed the toggle, exact scope, timestamp, and whether a gradual canary rollback would have prevented the hit. Tag eng-platform.

ajit: added audit note and linked INC-2026-60123. handing to payments for RCA. Thanks all.

ken: small ops note: if someone omits the --audit field the audit pipeline will flag the event for manual review and audit-bot leaves a comment.

audit-bot: evt_toggle_2026_33421: audit field present and sufficient. No manual review required.

maria: reminder: for non-emergency planned rollbacks use the rollout service with scheduled canary adjustments, not the emergency CLI. This helps preserve metrics and automated rollback rules.

ajit: noted. closing updates here once payments confirms RCA :thumbsup:
